data.name: Mohanlal
data.gender_notes: Mohanlal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mohanlal is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Delight of the Gods'. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Vishnu, who is often depicted as Mohan, the enchanter or the one who delights the senses. The name Mohanlal carries the meaning “Delight of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mohanlal usually hope their child will grow to embody delight of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
